Tariff No. 25: Tariff Changes with Customer and Commission Notification
45 day notice to customers for all tariff changes per RCW 81.28.050. Solid Waste Companies are also 
supposed to receive 75 notice for all tip fee increases per RCW 70A.205.160.
Notify customers of change on their first bill on July 1, 2026.
On May 18, 2026, the Company received notification of a Tip Fee increase from Cowlitz County Impacting 
the Company effective July 1, 2026.
The historic practice is to notify customers of a tip fee increase on their first bill per WAC 480­70­271(2)(a). 
This allows the Company to keep rate payer costs down by avoiding unnecessary printing and postage. 
Additionally the Company was given less than 75 days notice requirement as stated in RCW 70A.205.160.
